evaluation_label: RobustSpring-aligned controlled corruptions applied to the public Spring training split
severity_policy: One published setting per corruption. Numeric severity 1 is a local label, not ImageNet-C severity 1. No SSIM retuning on the training subset.
exactness: Published parameters with explicit local numerical conventions; official generator/seed/codec equivalence is not established.
seed_policy: sha256(2026|scene|frame|seed_key|eye), first four digest bytes little endian; NumPy default_rng PCG64; noise independent across eyes and frames
quantization: RGB uint8 input/output; floating operations clip to [0,255] then NumPy rint (nearest-even); JPEG/PIL resize use their native uint8 outputs

gaussian_blur.implementation: OpenCV GaussianBlur uint8, automatic kernel size, BORDER_REFLECT_101; byte-identical to legacy blur implementation

gaussian_noise.implementation: Independent HWC Gaussian draws per image; legacy seed key intentionally retained for paired amplitude sensitivity

shot_noise.implementation: Poisson((RGB/255)*23)/23 independently per HWC element and image

brightness.implementation: Add 0.39 to normalized RGB, literal paper Eq.4 interpretation
brightness.unresolved: ImageNet-C ancestor instead adds to HSV V; RobustSpring does not explicitly identify this color-space implementation choice. Excluded from proposed core.

contrast.implementation: (RGB-mean_HW(RGB))*0.16+mean_HW(RGB); mean axes follow the cited ImageNet-C ancestor, not a confirmed RobustSpring generator

jpeg_compression.implementation: Pillow JPEG encode/decode, explicit 4:2:0; codec version must be recorded; paper specifies quality only

pixelate.size_rounding: floor separately for width and height
pixelate.implementation: BOX down/up from cited ancestor, adapted to non-square native size; no coordinate warp or GT modification
